<thought>We need to obtain a list of templates applicable to the target molecule so we can pick a suitable amide‑formation template (its ID will be used in the route). We'll request templates for the target SMILES without additional functional‑group filters.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1",
  "limit": 10
}</action_input>
